name: openkline
description: A framework-independent, extensible financial chart engine.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:core && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/tests/core.test.js test-dist/tests/datafeed.test.js test-dist/tests/datafeed-adapters.test.js test-dist/tests/series.test.js test-dist/tests/react.test.js test-dist/tests/indicators.test.js test-dist/tests/drawings.test.js test-dist/tests/plugins.test.js test-dist/tests/workspace.test.js test-dist/tests/klinescript.test.js
scripts.package:check: npm run build && NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/openkline-npm-cache npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
